timecoded_text_to_speech.text: So we leave her in this very room.
She's heartbroken about Henry not marrying her.
She's heartbroken about not being able to have a baby.
I didn't know you couldn't conceive.
Oh!
Only one thing has ever made me consider marriage.
My own child.
So really, you leave her completely in limbo
and she's positive, but she kind of has nothing to really hang on to.
Find what makes you happy.
Promise me.
And then we find her in Hawaii.
She's very happy and she has this new hope, which I can't talk about,
but it's the best gift you could give Anna.
And she's writing and she's with Livy and she's in the sun
and all of her costumes became very vibrant.
And positive.
There is that kind of hope to Anna that she'll pull it off
or that she'll find happiness or she'll some way, in some way, get through.
She never doubted herself in that way.
Her whole world had crumbled, but I always knew she'd be okay.
